design_philosophy: Mobile-first utility with maximum clarity. The map is the primary canvas. The UI floats above it with clean lines, high-contrast typography, and purposeful motion. Color is stripped back, used exclusively to highlight actionable elements or the cheapest fuel prices (function-first).

rules: Labels must be uppercase and widely tracked.
95% of UI must be monochrome (White, Grey, Black).
Color is used STRICTLY for function (e.g., Green = Cheapest fuel).
Never use pure #000000, tint it slightly if needed, but for Swiss it can be stark.
Glassmorphism must have a 1px white/20 border.
Mobile-first: default layouts must be optimized for thumb reach.
Floating UI elements should have generous outer margins (e.g., `m-4`) to not feel cramped against device edges.
List view should be dense enough to show 4-5 stations per screen, but breathable.

search_bar.description: Floating pill at the top of the map for City Autocomplete.
search_bar.style: Crystal Glass style (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg border border-black/5 rounded-full). Includes an icon and clear text input.
search_bar.behavior: Expands downward into a dropdown for autocomplete suggestions.

filters.description: Fuel Type dropdown and Sort toggle.
filters.style: Neumorphic/Crisp pills situated right below or next to the search bar. High contrast active states (Black bg, white text).

map_markers.description: Custom Leaflet DivIcons showing the price directly on the map.
map_markers.style_normal: White pill, black text, subtle shadow.
map_markers.style_cheapest: Vibrant Green pill (#10B981), white text, pulsing ring animation (using absolute positioned element with ping animation).

station_card.description: Appears when a marker is tapped, or as items in the List View.
station_card.style: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no massive shadow. Clean geometric layout.
station_card.content_layout: Header: Station Brand Logo/Name + Distance. Body: Big Price Display + Address. Footer: 'Naviga' (Google Maps link) CTA.
station_card.cta_style: Black button with white text, full width in details, with a navigation icon.

view_toggle.description: Floating Action Button at bottom center to switch Map/Lista.
view_toggle.style: Pill shaped, solid black background, white text, heavy shadow. Icon + Text (Mappa / Lista).

list_transition.effect: Slide up from bottom (y: '100%' to y: 0) for the List View, while Map stays in background.

hover_states.buttons: Slight scale-down (scale: 0.98) on tap/click. Black buttons turn dark gray.

map_interactions.fly_to: Smooth zoom and pan to the selected city or marker.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2 or 2.5 for a crisp, technical look.

image_urls.description: Abstract/Minimal gas station detail for empty states or welcome screen (if any).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application is wrapped in an Italian locale context (e.g. standardizing decimals with commas for prices, like '1,759 €').
Use react-leaflet for the map. You MUST implement a custom DivIcon for markers to show the actual price string on the map itself.
Implement 'Cheapest station highlight' logic: scan the loaded stations, find the minimum price, and apply the 'style_cheapest' class to that specific marker.

Use `framer-motion` for the List/Map toggle. The map should always render in the background to preserve state, and the List View should animate over it (or hide map conditionally but preserving instance).
All text must be in Italian ('Cerca città', 'Tipo di Carburante', 'Prezzo', 'Naviga', 'Lista', 'Mappa').
The 'Naviga' button should format a URL like: `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=${lat},${lng}`.
Ensure 100% testability by adding `data-testid` attributes to inputs, buttons, map markers, and cards.
